opening.argument: The presentation makes paid participation the gateway to the promoted opportunity. It offers packages from one hundred to 5,000 euros, with tokens directed to mining, while describing the package as the product and linking it to tokens, mining slots and OneCoin. The growth chart projects an increase from C0.5 to C5.00 within one year, and the speaker reinforces that appreciation claim by saying the coins could reach 100 times their value and provide retirement income. The educational framing does not change the central solicitation: viewers are urged to learn more and “Lock in your position” because the organizations are growing quickly. Together, the paid packages, mining participation, projected growth and wealth claims encourage commitment to token purchase for anticipated appreciation or returns.
